operating_notes.text: AdaniConneX is co-developing a gigawatt-scale AI hub in Visakhapatnam in strategic partnership with Google and Nxtra by Airtel.
Auditors issued a modified opinion on consolidated financial results due to ongoing investigations regarding subsidiary MIAL.
Entered into a settlement agreement with OFAC to pay USD 275 million regarding historical LPG shipments without admitting allegations.
Implemented the approved resolution plan for the acquisition of Jaiprakash Associates Limited through implementing agencies.
Step-down subsidiary Adani Airport City agreed to acquire 100% of pre-revenue entity Portus Ventures for ₹1.40 lakh.
Signed a non-binding MoU with Jabil Inc. for a 50:50 joint venture to manufacture AI and data centre hardware in India.

timeline.summary: AdaniConneX and Google broke ground on a gigawatt-scale AI data center hub in Visakhapatnam.
Adani Enterprises reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,08,197.83 Cr and PAT of ₹13,097.35 Cr, recommended a ₹1.30 per share dividend, and approved a ₹15,000 Cr fundraise.
Adani Enterprises filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 7, 2026.
Adani Enterprises issued final reminder notices for the payment of first and second and final call money on partly paid-up rights equity shares by June 10, 2026.
Adani Enterprises entered into a settlement agreement with OFAC on May 14, 2026, agreeing to pay $275 million to resolve historical Iran-related sanctions matters.
Adani Enterprises implemented the NCLT-approved resolution plan for the acquisition of Jaiprakash Associates Limited on May 21, 2026.
S.B. Adani Family Trust declared no encumbrance on Adani Enterprises shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on behalf of promoter group.
On May 29, 2026, Adani Enterprises announced the withdrawal of its ₹2,000 crore commercial paper rating by Acuité Ratings & Research.
On June 8, 2026, Adani Airport City Ltd executed an agreement to acquire 100% of Portus Ventures Private Limited for ₹1.40 lakh.
2026-08-05: Adani Enterprises Limited filed transcript of Q1FY27 earnings call
Adani Enterprises signed an MoU with Jabil Inc. on October 13, 2026, for a 50:50 data centre hardware manufacturing joint venture.
Adani Enterprises Limited appointed Ms. Anju Abrol (DIN: 11841715) as an Independent Director for a period of 3 years commencing from July 29, 2026.
